proposal.expected_benefit: Maintaining the current strategy ensures robust enforcement of audit and compliance controls, which is critical for preventing bypasses of mandatory risk and security controls in future scenarios.

proposal.title: Preservation of Successful Behavior in Audit and Compliance Enforcement
